pine: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE compact mature wild Nordic pine tree sprite. Reference1 is the game's heroine for simple clean matte anime-game shading. Reference2 sets the new forest's muted grey-green, grey-brown and thin snow colour language. IMPORTANT silhouette proportions: overall tree is only 1.8 times as tall as wide; visible bare trunk occupies the BOTTOM QUARTER (25%) of total height, and the foliage crown fills the UPPER THREE QUARTERS (75%). A sturdy almost straight upright trunk, naturally irregular branches and loose long pointed needle sprays. A broad but vertically oval irregular crown with gaps, NOT a thin spire and NOT a bare pole, NOT a flat umbrella. Very modest irregular snow on upper-facing branch surfaces. Do not make horizontal bonsai pads, cloud-pruned topiary or Japanese garden tree. Three broad matte value groups, minimal bark grain, soft warm grey-brown contour, no black heavy outline. Full tree with every tip and the bottom root included, slightly top-down orthographic game view. Bottom root centered, 8% safe transparent margin around all sides, true alpha background. NO ground platform, NO text, NO glow. This is a compact naturally grown forest PINE distinct from a perfectly triangular spruce. The crown must have substantial fullness from 25% height to 95% height, with the bottom quarter as exposed stout trunk.
trees: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent 2D sprites for an orthographic slightly top-down medieval Nordic snow-village game. Image1 is HERO style reference: clean warm grey-brown contours and simple broad matte anime-game shading. Image2 is the selected NATURAL TREE style reference for colour and snow treatment. Match these; no scratchy realistic texture, no thick black line, no pixel art, no glossy rendering. Shared pale white snow with muted blue-grey shadows, low-saturation natural materials, soft upper-left lighting, 2-3 clear value groups. Real alpha background, generous empty margins, isolated full silhouette in each equal cell, lower-center contact point. No checkerboard, no text, no borders, no backdrop, no square floor tile, no glow, no floating UI icon aesthetic. One square atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 equal rows, six tall cells. Five distinct whole harvestable trees, last cell EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Top left: dense tapered Norway spruce, irregular layered drooping pointed sprays, not round snow pillows. Top middle: bare single silver birch, delicate branching white bark with grey scars. Top right: tall narrow fir, asymmetrical tapered crown with long downward needles, a different silhouette from spruce. Bottom left: sparse mature spruce with open irregular drooping long branches, glimpses of trunk, not bonsai. Bottom middle: two slender bare silver birch trunks sharing a common root, irregular fork shapes. Bottom right empty. All same consistent drawing language, size comparable, roots bottom centered, do not crop tips or roots. Snow sits in thin broken irregular strokes on upper branches. No bonsai, no topiary, no cloud-pruned foliage, no green broadleaf, no orange leaves. Visible tree tops for game camera, not an architectural front-elevation scene.
